papers.title: Telemedicine-based outpatient consultations for hypertension management in rural areas of Kazakhstan.
papers.abstract: Hypertension is a leading cause of cardiovascular morbidity and premature mortality worldwide. Limited access to specialist care in rural areas contributes to suboptimal blood pressure control and persistent healthcare disparities. Telemedicine offers a potential solution to bridge this gap. This retrospective observational study assessed the feasibility of WhatsApp-based teleconsultations for managing arterial hypertension in rural Kazakhstan. The intervention was conducted in three remote villages served by a district medical center. Patients with uncontrolled hypertension or cardiovascular symptoms were referred for remote cardiology consultations via WhatsApp, integrated with the national electronic health record system. Data on clinical decisions, treatment modifications, and patient self-monitoring behaviors were analyzed. A patient satisfaction survey was conducted between September and December 2024. A total of 78 patients with arterial hypertension were included. Most consultations were conducted at patients' homes using smartphones. Stage 3 hypertension was observed in 63% of participants. Treatment adjustments were made in 73.1% of cases following teleconsultation. Gender differences were identified in self-monitoring practices, with women more likely to perform regular home blood pressure monitoring. Among 54 respondents, 82% reported convenience of teleconsultations, and 63% expressed high satisfaction with the quality of care. Mobile-based teleconsultation using widely available messaging platforms is a feasible and acceptable approach that may improve access to specialist care. This model demonstrates potential for integration into primary healthcare systems to support hypertension management in resource-limited environments. Further studies are needed to evaluate clinical outcomes and long-term effectiveness. Not applicable.
papers.summary: 本研究探討了在哈薩克農村地區利用WhatsApp進行遠距心臟科會診以管理高血壓的可行性。研究納入78名患者，結果顯示73.1%的病例在遠距諮詢後調整了治療方案，且女性患者更常進行家庭血壓監測。多數患者認為此方式便捷（82%）且對照護質量感到滿意（63%），證實了基於普及通訊軟體的遠距醫療模式能有效改善偏鄉地區的專科醫療可及性。
papers.significance: 該研究驗證了在醫療資源有限的環境下，整合現有通訊軟體與國家電子病歷系統的遠距醫療模式具有高度可行性與接受度。這不僅為縮小城鄉醫療落差提供了低成本、易推廣的解決方案，也為將遠距醫療穩健納入基層醫療體系以優化慢性病管理提供了重要的實證基礎與未來發展方向。

papers.title: Out-of-pocket health expenditures and financial protection in Türkiye: pre-pandemic (2019) and COVID-19 era (2022) microdata.
papers.summary: 本研究利用土耳其2019年（疫情前）與2022年（COVID-19期間）的微觀數據，分析該國自付醫療支出的變化，並評估這兩個時期民眾所獲得的醫療財務保護水平。
papers.significance: 此研究有助於量化公共衛生危機對家庭醫療財務負擔的實質影響，為政策制定者在後疫情時代強化醫療保險制度與提升財務風險防護能力提供重要的實證參考。

papers.title: Neural-molecular signatures of insomnia: Insights from signed differential mapping and gene expression analysis.
papers.abstract: Insomnia disorder (ID) exhibits considerable heterogeneity in neuroimaging findings across studies, and whether functional brain alterations are consistent across resting and task states remains unclear. This study aimed to identify neural dysfunction across states in ID and explore its transcriptomic correlates. We conducted coordinate-based meta-analyses on 29 whole-brain fMRI studies (22 resting-state, 7 task-based; 2,579 participants: 1,305 ID, 1,274 healthy controls). Conjunction and contrast analyses were performed to disentangle state-common from state-specific alterations. Functional decoding via BrainMap characterized the behavioral profile of convergent regions. Meta-analytic spatial patterns were subsequently correlated with transcriptomic data using partial least squares regression. The main meta-analysis revealed three convergent network disruptions: salience network hyperactivity, default mode network hypoactivity, and executive circuit dysfunction. State-specific analyses showed that resting-state alterations specifically involved left insula and fusiform gyrus hyperactivity, while task-based alterations implicated anterior cingulate hypoactivity and left inferior temporal gyrus hyperactivity. Critically, conjunction analysis identified state-common hypoactivation of the rIFG as the sole convergent abnormality across both brain states, which functional decoding linked to inhibitory control, working memory, action observation, and attention. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that this spatial pattern of functional alterations was significantly associated with synaptic signaling genes (positive loading) and carbohydrate metabolism and mitochondrial function genes (negative loading). These findings delineate a state-common and state-specific neural signatures of ID, with state-common rIFG hypoactivation representing a robust neural substrate of executive dysfunction, and implicate synaptic and metabolic molecular pathways in the biological underpinnings of ID.
papers.summary: 本研究透過對29項全腦fMRI研究的坐標元分析，探討失眠症在不同大腦狀態（靜息態與任務態）下的神經功能障礙及其轉錄組學關聯。研究發現失眠症整體存在凸顯網絡過度活躍、預設模式網絡活躍度降低及執行迴路功能障礙。狀態特異性分析顯示靜息態涉及左腦島與梭狀回過度活躍，任務態則為前扣帶回活躍度降低。值得注意的是，右額下回的活躍度降低是唯一跨兩種狀態共有的神經異常，與抑制控制等執行功能相關。轉錄組學分析進一步將此空間模式與突觸信號傳導基因（正相關）及碳水化合物代謝與粒線體功能基因（負相關）連結起來。
papers.significance: 本研究首次釐清了失眠症在靜息態與任務態下的共有及特異性神經特徵，確立右額下回功能低下作為失眠症執行功能障礙的穩健神經基礎。此外，將宏觀腦功能異常與微觀轉錄組特徵（突觸與代謝通路）相結合，不僅為失眠症的病理生理機制提供了多維度的生物學證據，更為未來針對特定神經迴路或分子通路的精準介入與藥物開發指明了新方向。

papers.title: The dynamic interplay between brain entropy and functional connectivity.
papers.abstract: Brain entropy (BEN) quantifies the irregularity of regional brain activity and serves as an index of neural complexity, yet how BEN co-varies with large-scale brain connectivity remains unclear. Given the brain's dynamic nature, this study examined how whole-brain connectivity patterns co-vary with recurring BEN states. Using a large resting-state fMRI data dataset (N = 812), we applied a sliding-window approach and k-means clustering to derive dynamic BEN states and their corresponding connectivity patterns. Four distinct BEN states were identified, each showing unique functional and cognitive relevance. A low-BEN state (State 1) was associated with a strongly segregated, weakly integrated organization and negative cognitive relevance, while a high-BEN state (State 4) showed a highly integrated but weakly segregated organization and neutral cognitive relevance. Two intermediate-BEN states differed in regional entropy and connectivity: State 2, with low entropy in the default mode (DMN), executive control (ECN), and salience (SAN) networks, showed positive cognitive relevance and balanced integration-segregation; State 3, with low entropy in sensorimotor (SMN) and visual networks (VN), showed no significant cognitive relevance. Moreover, BEN-connectivity correlations were significantly negative and varied across states, being strongest in the cognitively relevant states. These findings demonstrate that the relationship between BEN and brain connectivity is dynamic and state-dependent, advancing BEN as a marker of the brain's complex, state-dependent functional organization.
papers.summary: 本研究利用大規模靜息態fMRI數據（N=812），探討大腦熵（BEN）與全腦功能連接動態狀態之間的關聯。研究識別出四種不同的BEN狀態：低BEN狀態表現出高度分離且微弱整合的連接特徵及負向認知相關性；高BEN狀態則呈現高度整合但微弱分離的特徵與中性認知相關性；兩個中間BEN狀態分別在不同網路展現差異化的熵值與連接模式，其中僅在特定網路具低熵的狀態具有正向認知相關性。此外，BEN與連接性之間呈顯著負相關，且相關強度因狀態而異。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了BEN與大腦連接之間的關係並非靜態，而是隨大腦動態狀態轉變，這推進了我們對大腦複雜且依賴狀態之功能組織的理解。透過將BEN的動態變化與認知功能相連結，該研究確立了BEN作為評估大腦動態神經複雜性與認知狀態潛力標記的重要地位。

papers.title: Social status modulates cooperative feedback processing: Electrophysiological evidence from an event-related potential study.
papers.abstract: Collaboration is essential, as both one's own and others' performance impact outcomes. However, little is known about how social status affects performance and reward processing during cooperation. This study used event-related potentials (ERPs) to investigate neural responses during cooperative tasks with high- and low-status partners, where participants were assigned middle status after a math competition. ERP signals were recorded as they observed self-performance, partner performance, and cooperative outcomes. Results revealed asymmetric processing: participants referenced their performance when evaluating others', while self-performance processing was less influenced by others'. In the self-other performance order, participants showed more negative feedback-related negativity (FRN) following others' incorrect performance after their own correct performance, and larger P2 to others' correct performance after their own incorrect performance. In the other-self order, smaller P2 and more negative FRN were found for self-incorrect performance regardless of partners' performance, with only the P2 effect larger when partners were incorrect. Moreover, high-status partners elicited more negative FRN than low-status partners when others performed correctly; this difference disappeared when others performed incorrectly. For order-independent cooperative outcomes, with high-status partners, the FRN was more negative and the P3a was smaller for self-loss than self-gain when partners gained, reversing when partners lost. With low-status partners, only the P3a difference persisted when partners gained, while both components mirrored the high-status pattern when partners lost. These findings suggest that social status shapes sequential cooperative feedback processing, particularly during the later integrative stage in which cooperative outcomes are evaluated under prior knowledge of self and partner performance.
papers.summary: 本研究透過事件相關電位（ERP）探討社會地位如何影響合作任務中的績效與獎勵處理。受試者在數學競賽中被賦予中等地位，並與高、低地位夥伴合作。結果發現績效處理存在不對稱性：受試者會以自身表現為基準評估他人，但自我績效處理較少受他人影響。腦電波分析顯示，當夥伴表現正確時，高地位夥伴會引發更負向的反饋相關負波（FRN）；而在評估最終的合作結果時，夥伴的社會地位顯著調節了受試者在整合階段的FRN與P3a成分反應。
papers.significance: 該研究首次從神經電生理學角度揭示了社會地位在序列性合作反饋處理中的關鍵調節作用。此發現不僅深化了對人際互動中資訊整合大腦機制的理解，對神經經濟學、組織行為學及團隊決策研究亦具重要參考價值，有助於解釋現實職場或金融團隊中，地位差異如何潛移默化地影響個體的認知評估與合作行為。

papers.title: Frequency-dependent modulation of human reward circuitry: A comparative study of theta, gamma, and high-frequency temporal interference.
papers.abstract: Temporal interference (TI) stimulation offers a noninvasive neuromodulation technique for targeting deep brain structures while sparing overlying cortical tissue. While early applications have validated TI's capacity to engage subcortical targets such as the hippocampus and striatum, the frequency-dependent mechanisms governing its efficacy remain poorly understood. This is particularly critical for the nucleus accumbens (NAc), a key hub in reward circuitry where invasive deep brain stimulation (DBS) typically operates at high frequencies (∼130 Hz). In this study, we investigated whether TI stimulation induces frequency-specific modulation of NAc activity and its functional coupling with the prefrontal cortex. Using a within-subject, counterbalanced design, we applied individualized NAc-targeted TI stimulation at three distinct envelope frequencies (5 Hz, 40 Hz, and 130 Hz) in 24 healthy adults. Resting-state fMRI was acquired pre- and post-stimulation. Results revealed a distinct dissociation between local and circuit-level effects: TI stimulation induced no statistically significant changes in local spontaneous activity within the NAc across any frequency condition. In contrast, 130 Hz stimulation selectively reduced functional connectivity between the NAc and the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC), whereas 5 Hz and 40 Hz conditions produced no such effect. Notably, despite the absence of significant group-level local modulation, the magnitude of individual NAc activity reduction under 130 Hz stimulation was significantly correlated with the extent of NAc-mPFC decoupling (r = -0.53). Exploratory analyses further revealed increased activity in the adjacent dorsal striatum (right putamen), consistent with a conduction-block model at the target core. These findings suggest that high-frequency TI mimics the network-disrupting effects of high-frequency DBS, offering evidence that TI can noninvasively modulate deep reward circuits in a parameter-specific manner for potential clinical application.
papers.summary: 本研究探討時間干擾（TI）刺激技術對人類獎勵迴路（特別是伏隔核NAc）的頻率依賴性調節作用。透過對24名健康成年人施以5 Hz、40 Hz及130 Hz三種不同包絡頻率的TI刺激，並結合靜息態fMRI掃描，結果發現TI刺激在各頻率下均未顯著改變NAc的局部自發性活動；然而，130 Hz的高頻刺激能選擇性地降低NAc與內側前額葉皮層的功能連結，且個體在130 Hz下NAc活動的減少量與此解耦程度顯著相關。此外，相鄰背側紋狀體的活動增加符合傳導阻滯模型。
papers.significance: 此研究證明了高頻（130 Hz）TI刺激能成功模擬侵入性高頻深部腦刺激（DBS）破壞神經網絡連結的效果，提供了TI技術能以非侵入性且參數特定方式調節深層獎勵迴路的關鍵實證。這不僅釐清了TI作用的頻率依賴機制，也為未來將TI技術應用於藥物成癮或憂鬱症等精神疾病的非侵入性臨床治療開闢了重要前景。

papers.title: Impact of prenatal exposure to airborne particulate matter on local functional connections in the cerebral cortex of neonates.
papers.abstract: Neuroimaging studies suggest that air pollution exposure interferes with brain functional development, potentially affecting long-term cognitive abilities. Early life may represent a critical window of vulnerability, yet most research has assessed exposure effects later in childhood, when postnatal influences accumulate. This study examined the early impact of prenatal exposure to airborne particulate matter (PM 2.5 ) on the functional structure of local connections in the cerebral cortex of neonates. This population-based study was conducted in Barcelona between 2018 and 2021. PM₂.₅ exposure was estimated using land-use regression models incorporating time-weighted maternal mobility data across distinct environments. Resting-state functional MRI scans were obtained from 61 neonates at 29 days postnatally. Brain functional connectivity was assessed using local Iso-Distant Average Correlation (IDAC) measures across different spatial distances. Voxel-wise regression analyses were performed to examine associations between PM 2.5 exposure and IDAC measures. Higher maternal PM 2.5 exposure during gestation was associated with stronger local functional connectivity in the neonatal cortex, particularly in brain regions involved in sensorimotor function. In the premotor and supplementary motor cortices, these effects varied by spatial scale, showing stronger associations at longer local distances. The findings suggest that prenatal exposure to air pollution interferes with early brain functional organization. Notably, the observed connectivity changes could reflect both a delay in the segregation of primary sensorimotor areas and the acceleration of functional maturation in higher levels of the sensorimotor system. Longitudinal studies are needed to track how these exposure-related alterations evolve over time and their potential impact on developmental outcomes.
papers.summary: 本研究探討產前暴露於空氣懸浮微粒（PM2.5）對新生兒大腦皮層局部功能連接的影響。針對巴塞羅納61名新生兒的靜息態功能性磁振造影分析顯示，孕期較高的PM2.5暴露量與新生兒大腦皮層（特別是感覺運動功能相關區域）更強的局部功能連接性顯著相關，且在運動前區與輔助運動皮層的較長局部距離上表現更為明顯。
papers.significance: 該研究首次於新生兒階段證實產前空氣污染會干擾大腦早期的功能組織發育，揭示其可能同時導致初級感覺運動區域分離延遲及高階感覺運動系統成熟加速。此發現填補了生命早期脆弱窗口期的研究空白，為理解環境汙染對長期認知發展的潛在影響提供了關鍵的早期神經影像學證據。
